facts.text: CommChannel opens a TCPIP VISA resource and identifies the instrument by *IDN? before returning the model class
MDO3000 builds its Oscilloscope subsystem with the ANALOG:NUMCHANNELS count of CONFIGURATION
sample_rate reads HORIZONTAL:SAMPLERATE? and is the rate the oscilloscope always acquires at
record_length takes 1e3, 1e4, 1e5, 1e6, 5e6 or 1e7 samples and is written as HORIZONTAL:RECORDLENGTH
horizontal_scale is the amount of time per division read and written as HORIZONTAL:SCALE
horizontal_delay_mode is delay_time or pretrigger_percent and is written as HORIZONTAL:DELAY:MODE ON/OFF
acquisition_mode is SAMPLE, PEAKDETECT, HIRES, AVERAGE or ENVELOPE
num_averages is the number of waveforms to average; the range is 2 to 512 in powers of 2
acquisition_state starts or stops the acquisition with RUN (1) or STOP (0)
single_acquisition writes ACQUIRE:STOPAFTER SEQUENCE for True and RUNSTOP for False
trigger_state is one of ARMED, AUTO, READY, SAVE or TRIGGER
read returns the acquired waveform samples as a WaveformDT or a numpy array
The upstream README reads channel CH1 through CommChannel and receives a waveform object
The MDO3000 series is one of the supported model families
